name: Taiju
source:
[i]"I do not wish for conflict. I do not wish for the blood of Itehari's people to be spilled."[/i]

Known as Itehari's living god. While this is a given for commoners, very few people have actually seen his face, even among nobility.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
